description: Defines the ue_manager class for managing UE contexts, configurations, dependencies, and related operations in a 5G/telecom software stack.

classes.name: ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UE contexts, handles their lifecycle, and maintains dependencies and configurations for UE management.

methods.name: get_next_ue_index
methods.description: Retrieves the next available UE index for a new UE.

methods.name: schedule_and_wait_ue_removal
methods.description: Schedules and waits for the removal of a UE identified by its index.
